limitations: Six classic/module dedicated/shared/service workers, four Offscreen PNG cases each, per baseline/protected profile.
Document controls independently cover eight cases / twelve carriers; they are not counted as worker exports.
Qt-decoded PNG pixels equal pre-mutation RGBA8 reads, preserve color metadata and match document outputs.
The exact public probe ran from a frozen 001-072 source layout with matching receipt, while 001-073 was building.
No worker restart/nesting, HDR fidelity, 001-073 runtime, security or release admission.
